g.data-timing: 2 x SYNC (BITS/J.211/DTI) RJ-45, IEEE 1588 RJ-45, 2 x inter-chassis sync RJ-45, 10 MHz and 1 PPS SMB
g.title: a99-rp3-se

rect.data-description: the four-character 5x7 LED dot-matrix display. The Overview and Reference Guide devotes two sections to what it shows - 'LED Matrix Boot Stage and Runtime Display' and 'LED Matrix CAN Bus Controller Error Display' - which is a message vocabulary rather than a lamp state list, so it is modelled as a display and not as an indicator with states.

circle.data-description: the Alarm Cut Off momentary push button. Pressing it after an alarm lights the ACO lamp: 'Alarm Cutoff has been enabled. The ACO push button was pressed after at least one alarm has occurred.'
the LAMP TEST momentary push button. On the RSP5 the guide adds that these two buttons 'can be used to eject the RSP5 card', which is why they are modelled as buttons and not as decoration.
Internal Solid State Hard Disk Drive (SSD). Green: SSD0 is busy/active, driven by the SSD controller. Off (default after reset): not busy/active.

FC Fault. Table 5, 'RP and RP2/RP3 Discrete LED Display Definitions' - amber: 'A fault has occurred on any or all of the FC cards installed. This LED will be on during the boot phase of the FC.' Off (default after reset): 'FC cards are booted up and ready.' A real vocabulary, from this card's own table.
GPS. Green: 'GPS interface provisioned and ports are turned on. ToD, 1 PPS, 10 Mhz are all valid.' Off (default after reset): either the interface is not provisioned or the ports are not turned on.
Critical Alarm (CRIT). Red: a critical alarm has occurred. Off (default after reset): no critical alarm has occurred.
Major Alarm (MAJ). Red: a major alarm has occurred. Off (default after reset): no major alarm has occurred.
Minor Alarm (MIN). Amber: a minor alarm has occurred. Off (default after reset): no minor alarm has occurred.
Power Fail (FAIL). Red: 'Standby Power Fail LED. The LED is turned off by the CAN bus controller after it is up and running.' Off: standby power is normal.
Alarm Cutoff (ACO). Amber: 'Alarm Cutoff has been enabled. The ACO push button was pressed after at least one alarm has occurred.' Off (default after reset): alarm cutoff is not enabled.

Synchronization (SYNC). Table 5, 'RP and RP2/RP3 Discrete LED Display Definitions' - this card's own table, not the RSP family's Table 4, and the two differ here. Green: 'System timing is synchronized to an external timing source INCLUDING IEEE 1588' - Table 4 omits the 1588 clause. Amber: system timing is free running. Off (default after reset): Cisco writes 'LED never turns off', which contradicts listing Off as a colour at all; off is kept as a declared state because the drawing needs an unlit appearance, and Cisco's sentence is recorded here rather than tidied away. Table 4 says 'No system timing is configured' for the same row, which is the RSP family's answer and is not this card's.
